description: Named visual directions. A direction is a coherent set of art-direction decisions that differ STRUCTURALLY from the others — hero strategy, panel grammar (`gridFamily`), navigation family, section order, heading treatment, responsive composition — not by palette, radius or token values. Every field here has a renderer or composer consumer; a dimension nothing reads would be a knob on a picture of a machine. `gridFamily` is the panel grammar: what a set of items in the middle of a page is MADE OF, emitted as its own structure by both renderers rather than as one DOM re-laid out by the stylesheet, and refused where the content cannot carry it. `assetAppetite` is checked against Visual Asset Readiness before a direction may become a candidate, so 'no publishable imagery' is an art-direction input rather than a late defect.

distinctiveMoments.__doc: What each declared distinctive moment is, and which section presentations carry it. A moment is an art-direction commitment, not a lucky selector: for every section type listed here the moment must have an implementation for EVERY variant that section can compile to, and each implementation must reserve layout rather than only paint a mark. tooling/distinctive-moment.test.mjs derives the variant list from the template component manifest, so adding a variant to a section immediately fails any moment that has not answered it.

figure-index.purpose: An index over what the practice offers. A business with no photography still has services, and numbering them says considered set rather than list that happened to be that long.

lead-statement.purpose: The opening claim set as a statement against a rule, rather than as body copy that happens to be first.

full-bleed-lead.purpose: The work breaks the measure and runs the width of the screen. The one place an imagery-led direction stops behaving like a document.

none.purpose: No distinctive moment. A deliberate declaration for a register whose whole point is restraint, not an absence to be filled in later. A direction that carries none is judged on rhythm and density instead.

structured-practice.label: Structured practice
structured-practice.purpose: An architectural, professional register. A regular grid, a split opening, and a rule above every section heading. Credibility comes from order and detail rather than from scale.

editorial-authority.label: Editorial authority
editorial-authority.purpose: Typography-led. The opening is a statement set in type with no picture beside it, items read as indexed rows rather than cards, and the page behaves like a document. Distinctive through hierarchy and restraint.

immersive-lead.label: Immersive lead
immersive-lead.purpose: Imagery-led. The lead photograph carries the opening, the work appears before the words about it, and the closing action sits mid-page so the page ends on contact. Requires publishable photography.

dense-utility.label: Dense utility
dense-utility.purpose: A surface that is worked in rather than read. A compact opening with the action on the same line, one ground throughout, and no decoration that costs vertical space.

schedule-register.label: Schedule register
schedule-register.purpose: A document register rather than a brochure. Sections are numbered like a contents page, item sets are ruled full-width rows read across instead of cards read down, and the measure is wide and flat. For a practice whose credibility is in structured, checkable detail rather than in photography - the register is a general typographic form, not one industry.

service-forward.label: Service forward
service-forward.purpose: Expressive and conversion-led without a single photograph. The opening is a large typographic statement rather than a picture, services are the argument and are laid out asymmetrically so a broad list reads as a considered offer rather than a table, and the ask is an edge-to-edge band a visitor meets before the page ends. For a business whose work is skilled but unphotographed and whose page exists to be acted on: the expressive vocabulary was previously reachable only through immersive-lead, which requires imagery, so any business without publishable photography was left with the restrained forms whatever its actual character. This is a general answer to expressive-and-imagery-poor, not a category of trade.
